# External inputs

Status as of 23 September 2026. Paths are set in `config.yaml`.

| Input | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **Parish boundaries** `boundaries/uga_admin4_parishes.gpkg` | ✅ **In place.** 553 parishes in the six GKMA districts (96 in Kampala) | UBOS, *Uganda administrative boundaries as of 17-08-2018* (parishes 2016, sub-counties 2017), on HDX: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/uganda-administrative-boundaries-as-of-17-08-2018 (licence CC0). The raw files are in `boundaries/ubos_2018/` |
| **Sub-county boundaries** `boundaries/uga_admin3_subcounties.gpkg` | ✅ **In place.** 79 sub-counties/divisions | Same source |
| Newer admin boundaries (2020 COD-AB) | Downloaded for reference only (`boundaries/uga_admin_boundaries.gdb`) | https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-uga. **Stops at sub-county**, and Kampala has only its 5 divisions, so it is too coarse for this paper |
| **Household income by parish** `parish_income.gpkg` / `.csv` | ✅ **In place.** Modelled median household income for 10,598 parishes (all of Uganda); 508 GKMA parishes matched to polygons | Built by `scripts/00_parish_income.py` from **published UBOS data only**. UNHS 2019/20 median monthly household income for all 15 sub-regions (report Table 5.21) is linked to a Census 2024 parish wealth index (TV, computer, grid power, water, sanitation, non-subsistence; first principal component, 61% of variance). Across sub-regions, log median income = 11.92 + 0.359 × mean wealth (R² = 0.65, n = 15). Parish median = sub-region median × exp(0.359 × (parish wealth − sub-region mean)), so every sub-region reproduces its UNHS median exactly. GKMA parish medians (2019/20 prices): Kampala 476k–1.11m (10th–90th percentile of parishes), Wakiso 163k–530k, Mukono 146k–406k. Uprated to 2026 by CPI in the affordability stage |
| **Income dispersion** `unhs_income_by_unit.csv` | ✅ In place | Gini: Kampala 0.342, Buganda South 0.428, Buganda North 0.343 (UNHS 2019/20 Table 6.10); **district** values for Wakiso 0.45 and Mukono 0.44 from the UBOS/UNICEF/World Bank *Poverty Map report* (Oct 2019, `ubos/publications/p33/`) |
| UBOS publications harvested | ✅ `ubos/publications/` | RPPI reports and press releases 2018–2026 (33 files); Census 2024 profiles (Kampala, Buganda and other sub-regions), MPI 2024 monograph, census Housing Monograph (tenure, muzigo), population by parish 2014, projections; poverty maps; UNHS 2005/06, 2012/13, 2016/17 reports. Manifests list every URL |
| **MoFPED Macro Data Portal** `mofped/` | ✅ **In place.** All 83 datasets (17 MB): catalogue in `mofped/catalog/`, one CSV per dataset in `mofped/datasets/` | Downloaded with https://github.com/gavacharles/mofped-macrodata-api-downloader (cloned in `tools/`), which uses the portal's official R API `ugatsdb`. Refresh: `Rscript tools/mofped-macrodata-api-downloader/download_all_macrodata.R data/external/mofped` |
| **USD→UGX** `bou_usd_ugx_monthly.csv` | ✅ **In place.** 1981-01 to 2026-07 | Built by `scripts/00_prepare_macro.py` from `BOU_E_M`: series `E_PA` (BoU period-average rate), falling back to `E_IFEM_MR` (interbank mid-rate). Daily rates are in `mofped/datasets/BOU_E.csv` |
| **CPI uplift** (`cpi_uplift` column) | ✅ **In place: 1.2969** | Built by `scripts/00_prepare_macro.py` from `BOU_CPI`: headline CPI (`CPI_16`, 2016/17 = 100), Aug 2026 ÷ mean over the UNHS fieldwork (Sep 2019 – Nov 2020). The housing, water and energy component (`CPI_HWEGF_16`) gives 1.2280 and is kept in `cpi_uplift.csv` for sensitivity. For the paper, re-run with `--target` set to the middle of the collection window |
| **Flood proxy** (OSM wetlands) | ✅ **In place.** 5,941 wetland polygons, 159 km² (`osm/wetlands.gpkg`) | OpenStreetMap `natural=wetland`. Kampala's floods are mostly flash floods in the wetland valleys (Lubigi, Nakivubo, Kinawataka), so the model uses distance to wetland and a within-200 m flag |
| Modelled flood hazard `flood_hazard_gkma.gpkg` | Optional upgrade | KCCA drainage master plan flood-prone areas (request from KCCA GIS: https://www.kcca.go.ug/gis). Global river-flood layers (JRC, WRI Aqueduct) are **not suitable**: they model river overflow, not Kampala's flash flooding |
| **Night-time lights** `viirs_annual_2024_uganda.tif` | ✅ **In place.** NASA Black Marble VNP46A4 2024 (Kampala CBD 61, Entebbe 19, Mukono 10 nW/cm²/sr); token in git-ignored `.env` | NASA Black Marble VNP46A4 annual, tiles h21v08 + h21v09: `scripts/00_fetch_night_lights.py` downloads, mosaics and clips to GKMA |
| **Construction cost** `replacement_cost_rates.csv` | ✅ **In place** (built by `scripts/00_prepare_construction_costs.py`) | CAHF (2020), *Uganda's Housing Construction and Housing Rental Activities*, Table 10: bill-of-quantities costs for Kampala house types at 2019 prices (PDF in `cahf/`), indexed to April 2026 with UBOS CIPI headline (×1.219, from `tools/cio_pipeline-2`). Standard house UGX 1.95m/m², apartment 3.11m, shell 1.17m (finishes = 40% of labour+materials, CAHF Table 11). The storeyed and high-spec classes rest on stated assumptions; see the `basis` column |
| **UBOS Residential Property Price Index** `ubos_rppi_quarterly.csv` | ✅ **In place.** Quarterly, 2015/16 to 2025/26 Q4, 5 areas | UBOS RPPI Excel tables (harvested by `tools/cio_pipeline-2`), tidied by `scripts/00_prepare_ubos.py`. Used to validate the listing-based price index and for time adjustment |
| **Census 2024 parish profiles** `census2024_parish.csv` / `.gpkg` | ✅ **In place.** 569 GKMA parishes, 2.11 million households; 93% of households matched to the 2016 parish polygons | UBOS NPHC 2024 sub-county profile tables (`ubos/harvest/NPHC-2024-Subcounty-Profiles-Excel-Tables.xlsx`), harvested from https://www.ubos.org/datasets/ with `tools/cio_pipeline-2`; parsed by `scripts/00_prepare_census.py`. Households, household size, and shares with TV, computer, grid power, improved water/sanitation, subsistence; plus a parish **wealth index** (first principal component, 72% of variance). Used as a model covariate and to count households priced out |
| Other UBOS tables `ubos/harvest/`, `ubos/publications/` | ✅ Harvested | 28 dataset tables (CPI monthly Oct 2025 – Aug 2026, quarterly GDP, household consumption, poverty dynamics) and the publication categories RPPI (128), Population & Censuses (20), Income/expenditure/poverty (33), Household surveys (23) and Statistical Abstract (74). Manifests list every file and URL |
| OSM amenities and roads `osm/*.gpkg` | ✅ In place | Schools 3,371 · health 1,592 · markets 615 · taxi stages 224 · major roads 2,311 segments |
